exposure: presence of an intrapartum birth companion of her choice
cohort: The study participants were women in labour at a tertiary care center in Aurangabad, India.
finding: The use of an intrapartum birth companion significantly reduced caesarean section rates, episiotomy rates, NICU admissions, and time to breastfeeding initiation, while increasing maternal satisfaction.
mod_finding: The presence of a birth companion significantly reduced caesarean section and episiotomy rates.
